results.name: ELEVEN SECONDS OF STILLNESS
results.tagline: One object. Eleven seconds. No explanation
results.blurb: You can stop a single object dead for eleven seconds, which is exactly long enough to catch a falling mug and exactly short enough to be useless in a real emergency. You spend the time on small rescues and you have never once used it to win an argument, though you have thought about it.
results.watchOut: You freeze at exactly the wrong moment too. Practise the big one.

results.name: THE ONE FREE DOOR
results.tagline: Any door, once, and then it's done
results.blurb: Every door opens for you exactly one time. This is a power with an obvious flaw: you have to decide, in advance, which door matters. You spend most of your life choosing carefully and occasionally waste it on a cupboard because you were tired.
strengths: Never takes an entrance for granted
results.watchOut: You hoard the good option until it expires. Use it.

results.name: THE LIE ON YOUR TONGUE
results.tagline: Every false sentence tastes of pennies
results.blurb: You can taste a lie. It sounds like a gift and it is mostly a burden, because now you know exactly how often people are being kind, and there is no way to un-know it. You are extremely well informed and extremely difficult to invite to dinner.
results.watchOut: You hear the lie and miss the kindness. Not everything false is hostile.

results.name: THE SHADOW THAT LEAVES THE HOUSE
results.tagline: It has its own plans and better social skills
results.blurb: Your shadow detached about a year ago and has been living a slightly more successful life alongside yours. It goes to the parties, handles the small talk and occasionally comes home with groceries. You are not sure which of you is the original and it has stopped mattering.
strengths: Two versions of you, one schedule
results.watchOut: You let it do the living. Take one evening back.

results.name: FOUR SECONDS BACK
results.tagline: Just enough time to not say it
results.blurb: You can rewind any conversation by four seconds, which is not enough to change the outcome and exactly enough to change the sentence. You have become an extraordinarily careful speaker and a slightly dishonest one, because you have quietly edited more conversations than you can count.
results.watchOut: You edit instead of apologising. Say the wrong thing and own it.

results.name: THE THING THAT COMES BACK
results.tagline: You lose nothing. You just wait
results.blurb: Anything you genuinely lose returns to you eventually, slightly worse for wear and faintly resentful. Keys, earrings, people. This has made you careless with possessions and strangely confident about relationships, and both of those are going to be a problem one day.
results.watchOut: Not everything returns. Treat the important things like they could leave.

results.name: THE BUILDING KNOWS YOU
results.tagline: It has opinions about your tenancy
results.blurb: You can talk to buildings. They are slow, petty and extremely well informed. Every place you have ever lived has had a grudge, a favourite corner and a long memory about something you did in 2019. You have learned to apologise to stairwells and it has improved your life enormously.
strengths: Good at making a space feel safe
results.watchOut: You absorb the mood of a room too easily. Some of it isn't yours.

results.name: THE SNEEZE THAT EDITS REALITY
results.blurb: Every time you sneeze, one small fact about the world changes. Nothing dramatic: a name, a colour, which side the handle is on. You have learned to sneeze facing away from anything important, and you keep a notebook, because nobody else notices and you have started to doubt yourself.
results.watchOut: You accept a changed world too easily. Check the facts.

results.name: EVERYONE'S COUSIN
results.tagline: They remember you warmly and cannot place you
results.blurb: Anyone you meet will remember you as a cousin. Not a specific cousin, just a cousin: warm, familiar, vaguely related. Doors open, awkwardness evaporates, and nobody can ever quite explain the connection. It is the most socially powerful thing in this quiz and the loneliest.
results.watchOut: Being everyone's cousin means being nobody's person. Be specific with one.
